summary: A 60-year-old Denver man died on a commercial multiday rafting trip on the Green River at Winnie's Rapid in the Canyon of Lodore; the two-person inflatable kayak flipped in the Class II rapid, he signaled he was OK while floating downstream, then showed signs of distress and lost consciousness before being pulled from the water. CPR was underway when the park was notified; a medical helicopter flew him to Memorial Hospital in Craig, where he was pronounced dead.
location: Winnie's Rapid, Canyon of Lodore, Green River, Dinosaur National Monument
responding_agency: NPS Dinosaur National Monument rangers; medical helicopter; Memorial Hospital, Craig
notes: Incident date from NPS report's "this past Saturday" (report dated 2017-06-14) = 2017-06-10 (Saturday-verified). Cardiac event suspected as cause, not confirmed; name withheld pending next-of-kin notification. Trip was with an authorized river outfitter out of Moab, Utah. Source: NPS morning-report compendium (orig. Fox 31 Denver). Run 539: merged Basin Now URL.
